born.why: The code eliminates the dangerous "mostly" heuristic which discarded rare poisonous items by averaging them with safe ones, instead treating any history of harm as definitive poison to avoid lethal mistakes. It prioritizes tasting novel fruits when safe (low hunger) to expand knowledge and eats known-safe fruits aggressively when felt hunger is high, ensuring survival without risking death on unknown threats.
